_comment: Engagement / warming config for X, Pinterest, Instagram. Per-platform daily action budgets and time windows. Skills read this; the user edits it.

global._note: platform_rotation order is shuffled each run; this is the seed order. min_gap_minutes_between_platforms is enforced via state file timestamps.

x._skipped_reason: follow + comment are higher bot-detection signals; add later after graduating

react._note: Pinterest's heart/reaction button on the pin detail page — the closest analog to an IG/X 'like'.

comment._note: Added 2026-05-05. Comment is OUTSIDE the 2-3 engagement bag — it has a separate planning rule: always 1 per pass + 50% chance of a 2nd. With ~1 Pinterest pick per day across the cron schedule, that averages 1-2 comments/day. Each comment pulls a phrase from config/comment-corpus.json and types it via scripts/type_human.sh (per-char with variable delays — uniform-speed typing is a bot signal even when the text is fine).

pinterest._skipped_reason: All four engagement actions enabled (save/react/follow/comment). Pinterest is more lenient than X/IG — comments enabled here first as the test platform. Defer comments on X (~2 weeks of clean Pinterest first), IG (last; may stay deferred indefinitely).

instagram._skipped_reason: IG is the most aggressive about bot-detection signals; start with scroll + like only

jitter._comment: All durations are milliseconds. Use scripts/jitter.sh to sample.
